fail_closed: Requesting a family not listed under 'families' is an error. There is no default family and no silent fallback.

gpt2.notes: No BOS. <|endoftext|> (50256) doubles as EOS and document separator. Byte fallback is inherent: all 256 bytes are vocab tokens.

llama.description: LLaMA-family SentencePiece BPE (H047 armvegr/sp_tokenizer.mojo); verified with TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 tokenizer.model
llama.notes: Prepend BOS (1) to prompts by default; append EOS (2) at end of generation. BYTE pieces <0x00>-<0xFF> cover bytes 0-255. Dummy U+2581 prefix is stripped on decode.

mistral.description: Mistral v1 SentencePiece BPE (compatible with armvegr/sp_tokenizer.mojo BPE path)
mistral.notes: Same special-token layout as LLaMA. Control tokens <0x00>-<0x09> etc. follow the same BYTE convention.

special_token_semantics.bos: Beginning-of-sequence. Prepended to the prompt when add_bos_default is true (LLaMA/Mistral). Absent in GPT-2 (null).
special_token_semantics.byte_fallback: When true, characters absent from vocab are encoded as their UTF-8 bytes via BYTE pieces (<0xHH>), never as UNK.
special_token_semantics.eos: End-of-sequence. Appended after generation; also used as a stop token during sampling. In GPT-2, <|endoftext|> (50256) serves this role.
special_token_semantics.pad: Padding token for batched inference. Null here: ARMVEGR inference is single-sequence (no batching), so no pad id is defined.
special_token_semantics.unk: Unknown token. Emitted only when byte fallback is unavailable and a character is not in vocab. With byte_fallback=true, UNK is effectively unreachable.
